scope: GPU-resident four-segment BF16 GQA attention cost baseline; no NanoKV, model, router, H2D, or custom attention kernel

provenance.scope: FA2 public operator baseline; no source patches

protocol.K_V: each [L,8,128] BF16 contiguous; current length equals T
protocol.mask: all first-three-segment history visible; current key j visible iff j <= query i; FA2 public causal bottom-right alignment

timed_arms.full_chain_pack_plus_fa2: torch.cat into reusable packed K/V buffers, then official public flash_attn_func
timed_arms.prepacked_fa2: official public flash_attn_func only, after identical K/V were packed outside timing
timed_arms.pack_only_diagnostic: reusable-buffer torch.cat only; separately reported and never subtracted from full-chain time

protocol.graph_update: small T=9 fixed-address graph updates Q and every K/V on a non-default stream, checks oracle output, then restores and hashes all inputs
protocol.no_output_allocation_claim: FA2 public API allocates its output; eager API timing includes that allocation behavior, while graph pool behavior is reported separately
